results.content: College of Arts and Sciences. # **AI Research in the College**. Artificial Intelligence (AI) research is shaping the future across all disciplines. From healthcare innovations to advancements in natural language processing and data science, our researchers are driving transformative projects that address global challenges. Explore how our faculty AI research initiatives are creating solutions that impact industries, communities and the world. ## AI research happening across the College. This is only a selection of the AI research happening across the College. Researches the impact of AI on misinformation, media bias and transparency in journalism, aiming to make news more reliable for the public. Uses AI to predict and study the effects of natural disasters on communities with the goal of improving resilience, preparation and sustainable response strategies. Develops AI models to study the flow of ice in Greenland and its impact on climate change. Studies the role of AI in spreading disinformation, focusing on deepfakes and the polarization of content on social media.

results.title: THE Awards Arab World 2025
results.content: “We have always been clear at THE that excellence can be found in universities of all sizes and missions. Rankings certainly offer one important, data-driven measure of esteem, but we know that higher education institutions are made up of teams and individuals displaying creativity and endeavour in an abundance which cannot always be captured by metrics or surveys. For this year's THE Awards Arab World to have received close to 700 submissions – nearly twice as many as last year – is a sure sign of the sector’s vibrancy in the region, and its resilience in the face of obstacles which to the outside observer seem sometimes insurmountable. This year’s 80 finalists exemplified these values in spades, and their efforts rightly add to the esteem of the region’s universities. International Strategy of the Year. AAU’s commitment to global engagement is reflected in its improved international rankings position, alignment with the United Nations’ SDGs, and active student participation in global challenges.
